name: Better olcRTC
description: Replaces the olcRTC core of the panel by the ghostlane-project fork (olcRTC v0.12.1: VK Calls, MTS Link, SaluteJazz, per-user keys, UDP, direct routes). The panel downloads the reviewed build itself and checks its hash; switch the plugin off and the core stays as it is. Needs Better Cores.
